story_ninth_archive/stage_gate_arch.alt: The Gate Arch: Verath’s outer arch, wide enough for four abreast and warded to read every one of them.

story_ninth_archive/cover.alt: Cover art for The Ninth Archive: Your sigil was erased. It still burns.

story_ninth_archive/key.alt: Key art for The Ninth Archive

story_ninth_archive/stage_commons.alt: The Commons: A long hall of scarred oak tables where the Academy pretends to be a school.

story_ninth_archive/stage_archive_stacks.alt: The Stacks: Rolling shelves on iron rails, packed close enough that you have to crank a gap to walk.

story_ninth_archive/stage_archive_floor.alt: Archive Reading Floor: Eight doors, eight brass numerals, and a reading floor between them where the lamps are kept deliberately low.

story_ninth_archive/stage_rooftop.alt: The Leads: Flat lead sheeting between two gables, out of the wind and out of the wards.

story_ninth_archive/stage_lecture_hall.alt: Arcane Lecture Hall: Steep banked benches around a demonstration well.

story_ninth_archive/stage_dorm.alt: Your Room: A bed, a desk, a window that does not quite close, and a door the Academy has a key to.

story_ninth_archive/stage_warden_office.alt: The Warden's Office: Warm, tidy, and hung with student portraits going back sixty years.

story_ninth_archive/ysolde.alt: Warden Ysolde Farrow, Warden of Records

story_ninth_archive/kael.alt: Kael Ostrand, Gate prefect, fifth year

story_understudy/cover.alt: Cover art for The Understudy: You know every line. Nobody knows you.

story_ninth_archive/mira.alt: Mira Senn, Archive assistant, third year

story_ninth_archive/bram.alt: Bram Ketch, Second year, unofficial quartermaster

story_understudy/stage_rehearsal_room.alt: Rehearsal Room Two: Sprung floor, one wall of mirrors, and a piano nobody is allowed to move.

story_understudy/stage_green_room.alt: The Green Room: Two sofas that have outlived four principals, a kettle, and a noticeboard where the cast list goes up.

story_understudy/stage_stage.alt: The Main Stage: Nine hundred empty seats and a ghost light burning at centre.

story_understudy/stage_wardrobe.alt: Wardrobe: Rails to the ceiling and the smell of steam.

story_understudy/stage_directors_office.alt: The Director's Office: One chair for him and one for whoever is in trouble.

story_salt_road/cover.alt: Cover art for The Salt Road: Eleven days of road. Nine days of water.

story_salt_road/stage_ossun_gate.alt: Ossun Gate: The last wall before the flats.

story_salt_road/key.alt: Key art for The Salt Road

story_salt_road/stage_first_well.alt: The First Well: A stone ring and a windlass that works.

story_salt_road/stage_the_wrecks.alt: The Wrecks: Four wagons in a rough line, upright, still loaded.

story_salt_road/stage_third_well.alt: The Third Well: Marked with a question mark on every map worth having.

story_salt_road/stage_second_well.alt: The Second Well: Sound, deep, and crowded.

story_salt_road/oren.alt: Oren, Joined at the second well

story_tidewall/cover.alt: Cover art for The Tidewall: Your sister died holding the wall.

story_tidewall/stage_muster_yard.alt: The Muster Yard: Forty paces of frozen sand between the barracks and the wall stair, raked flat every morning by whoever came last to breakfast.

story_tidewall/stage_wall_walk.alt: The Wall Walk: The top of the Tidewall, wide enough for three abreast and nothing else, running east and west until it stops being a wall and starts being weather.

story_tidewall/stage_beast_lines.alt: The Animal Lines: Pens, perches and a long roofed run where the orders keep everything they ride, fly, or answer to.

story_tidewall/stage_bright_hall.alt: The Bright Hall: A drum-shaped stone room sunk below the yard where the sorcerers of the wall bind their first element and argue about the second.

story_tidewall/stage_stillhand_tent.alt: The Stillhand Tents: Six canvas halls behind the yard, lit day and night, where the wall’s wounded are sorted by how long they have.

story_tidewall/stage_eleventh_gate.alt: The Eleventh Gate: A gatehouse and a low crossing where the ground comes up to meet the wall, which is why the tide chose it.

story_tidewall/odalys.alt: Drillmaster Odalys Verne, Drillmaster of the intake

story_tidewall/stage_longwatch_post.alt: The Longwatch Post: A stone spur pushed out from the wall so archers can see along the face of it.

story_tidewall/bec.alt: Bec Tarrow, Longwatch archer, survivor of the eleventh gate

story_tidewall/ansett.alt: Commander Sabel Ansett, Commander of the eastern run

story_tidewall/hollis.alt: Hollis Ferrant, Stillhand recruit, first on the roll

story_unbound/cover.alt: Cover art for The Unbound: Your school was dissolved. You were not.

story_unbound/stage_kiln_yard.alt: The Kiln Yard: A walled square of packed red earth behind the Kiln’s furnaces, warm even before sunrise.

story_unbound/stage_river_stair.alt: The River Stair: Ninety wide stone steps from the upper city down to the water, where students from all five schools pass each other twice a day and pretend not to look.

story_unbound/stage_contract_office.alt: The Contract Office: A long counter, five queues, and a board of work the schools have agreed to let students take.

story_unbound/stage_night_market.alt: The Night Market: Four streets of awnings along the water that only open after dark, selling food, salt, and the occasional thing a school would confiscate.

story_unbound/stage_oyan_house.alt: Oyan House: Your old school, doors sealed with a Concord band and a wax stamp, everything still inside it.

story_unbound/stage_concord_hall.alt: The Concord Hall: Where five schools that would rather not agree do it in writing anyway.

story_unbound/renna.alt: Renna Vosk, Kiln instructor, holds your probation

story_unbound/stage_confinement_house.alt: The Confinement House: Three rooms behind the Concord where people awaiting a ruling are kept comfortably and absolutely.

story_unbound/auber.alt: Reader Auber Kell, Concord reader, took the Oyan ruling

story_unbound/sera.alt: Sera Ilm, Oyan student, sent to the Long Quiet

story_unbound/tam.alt: Tam Ashgrove, Kiln full student, third year

story_nine_weeks/cover.alt: Cover art for Nine Weeks: You came back. So did they.

story_nine_weeks/stage_staff_cabins.alt: The Staff Cabins: Six timber cabins behind the car park, four bunks each, a shared bathroom with one good shower.

story_nine_weeks/stage_kitchen.alt: The Kitchen: Hot, loud, and the actual centre of this building.

story_nine_weeks/stage_back_steps.alt: The Back Steps: Four concrete steps between the kitchen door and the bins, facing the pines.

story_nine_weeks/stage_the_dock.alt: The Dock: Boards out over the water, four boats tied up, and the only place on the property where you can be seen by everyone and overheard by nobody.

story_nine_weeks/stage_town_road.alt: The Road Into Town: Twenty minutes of tarmac with no lights on it, walked at two in the morning by people who wanted twenty minutes of not being at work.

story_nine_weeks/stage_longhouse_bar.alt: The Longhouse Bar: A long room with the lake down one whole side and a small stage at the end that gets used more nights than not.

story_nine_weeks/stage_the_point.alt: The Point: A shingle spit on the far shore with one dead tree on it, twenty minutes across the water and out of sight of the whole property.

story_nine_weeks/juno.alt: Juno Vale, Bar staff, second season

story_nine_weeks/nadia.alt: Nadia Okonkwo, Head of house, fourth season

story_nine_weeks/cass.alt: Cass Reyner, Bar staff, third season

story_red_moon/stage_the_ramparts.alt: The Ramparts: Forty feet up, wide enough for four abreast, and open to whatever the wind is carrying.

story_red_moon/stage_fort_ember.alt: Fort Ember: Barracks, armoury, muster yard and mess, all built into the inside face of the city wall.

story_red_moon/key.alt: Key art for Red Moon Brigade

story_red_moon/stage_infirmary.alt: The Infirmary: Thirty beds, eleven occupied, and a smell of iodine that gets into your coat.

story_red_moon/stage_voss_lab.alt: The Specimen Hall: Two floors underground, and colder than the rest of the fort by design.

story_red_moon/stage_vale_office.alt: Commander Vale’s Office: One desk, one map, one chair for visitors, and sixty years of the Brigade in the things on the walls.

story_red_moon/stage_outer_gate.alt: The Outer Gate: Two doors of banded iron, forty feet high, and a killing yard behind them.

story_red_moon/stage_ash_flats.alt: The Ash Flats: Twelve miles of pale grit where a forest used to be.

story_red_moon/stage_the_undercroft.alt: The Undercroft: Below the specimen hall, behind a door with a sixty-year-old lock.

story_red_moon/lyra.alt: Captain Lyra Venn, Your squad captain

story_red_moon/ren.alt: Ren Calder, The other recruit who was going to be first

story_red_moon/stage_sunken_town.alt: Kelder’s Reach: A town a Behemoth walked through eleven years ago.

story_red_moon/serah.alt: Commander Serah Vale, The Brigade’s commander

story_red_moon/wick.alt: Wick, Someone else the Behemoths did not finish

story_red_moon/quiet_one.alt: The Quiet One, Behemoth — and possibly not

story_seven_days/stage_the_platform.alt: Halcyon Bay Station: One platform, a canopy with a hole in it, and a view straight down the hill to the water.

story_seven_days/key.alt: Key art for Seven Days to Midnight

story_seven_days/stage_the_esplanade.alt: The Esplanade: A curve of shopfronts facing the water.

story_seven_days/stage_boarding_house.alt: The Boarding House: Four rooms, a landlady who does not ask questions, and a kitchen you are allowed to use until nine.

story_seven_days/stage_the_library.alt: The Public Library: One room upstairs above the old assembly hall.

story_seven_days/stage_the_marina.alt: The Marina: Eighty berths, maybe thirty of them used.

story_seven_days/stage_the_clock_tower.alt: The Clock Tower: Top of the hill, ninety feet, and stopped at 11:59 since before anybody alive was born.

story_seven_days/stage_council_hall.alt: The Council Hall: Municipal, 1890s, and much too big for a town this size.

story_seven_days/stage_the_point.alt: The Point: The headland past the marina.

story_seven_days/theo.alt: Theo Marr, The boy at the middle table

story_seven_days/stage_the_old_town.alt: The Old Town: Six streets of stone cottages above the front, most of them holiday lets.

story_seven_days/mina.alt: Mina Arclight, The first person you meet, every Monday

story_seven_days/wynn.alt: Detective Sera Wynn, Investigating something that has not happened yet

story_seven_days/ivy.alt: Ivy Sable, The one who disappears on Wednesday

story_seven_days/elias.alt: Elias Crowe, The man everyone says is unwell

story_seven_days/harrow.alt: Councillor Ada Harrow, Arrives Thursday, leaves Friday

story_blackwake/stage_the_marrow.alt: The Marrow: Forty feet of forty-year-old cutter with a cracked keel, one suit of tired sails, and nobody aboard her but you.

story_blackwake/stage_saltmarket.alt: Saltmarket: Four hundred years of harbour built on top of itself.

story_blackwake/stage_the_yard.alt: Corrow’s Yard: A slipway, three sheds, and a woman who can tell you what is wrong with your ship from sixty feet away and will, at length.

story_blackwake/stage_the_crownless.alt: The Crownless Sea: Nine hundred square miles of water that is on no chart printed in ninety years, and everything in it that is the reason for that.

story_blackwake/stage_stormlee.alt: Stormlee: An island inside a storm that has not stopped in living memory.

story_blackwake/nessa.alt: Nessa Vale, Navigator, wanted in three ports

story_blackwake/stage_the_drift.alt: The Drift: A lawless port built across nine hulks lashed together and grown into each other.

story_blackwake/veyra.alt: Captain Veyra Sol, Ninth Fleet, inshore squadron

story_blackwake/tolla.alt: Tolla Corrow, Shipwright, owns the yard

story_blackwake/harrow_bell.alt: Harrow Bell, Broker at the Drift

story_blackwake/mako.alt: Mako Renn, Diver, sixteen, absolutely certain

story_red_moon/cover.alt: Cover art for Red Moon Brigade: You hunt monsters. You are becoming one.

story_seven_days/cover.alt: Cover art for Seven Days to Midnight: The city ends Sunday. Only you remember.

story_blackwake/cover.alt: Cover art for Blackwake: A broken ship. Nobody knows your name.

story_last_five/stage_kosei_gym.alt: The Kosei Gym: Two courts, one of them with a dead spot near the left elbow that everybody knows about.

story_last_five/stage_locker_room.alt: The Locker Room: Eleven lockers, six of them in use.

story_last_five/stage_film_room.alt: The Film Room: A storage cupboard with a projector in it.

story_last_five/stage_kosei_school.alt: Kosei High: Corridors, a vending machine that only takes exact change, and the staff office where the board’s letter came from.

story_last_five/stage_away_seiran.alt: Seiran Academy: A gym with seating for two thousand and a scoreboard that works.

story_last_five/stage_away_tessen.alt: Tessen Industrial: A converted factory floor with a court in it.

story_last_five/stage_away_hakuba.alt: Hakuba West: A public school gym with a leaking roof and the best point guard in the prefecture.

story_last_five/stage_away_onda.alt: Onda Commercial: Loudest gym in the prefecture, and most of it is one person talking.

story_last_five/coach.alt: Ena Torakawa, Head coach, second year

story_last_five/stage_nationals.alt: The National Championship: Nine thousand seats, a floor laid this morning, and a programme with Kosei printed in it.

story_last_five/bo.alt: Bo Ferrand, Centre, second year, six weeks of experience

story_last_five/jun.alt: Jun Hasabe, Shooting guard, second year

story_last_five/kai.alt: Kai Sumire, Point guard, first year

story_last_five/rei.alt: Rei Amagi, Seiran Academy · scoring guard

story_last_five/tsubame.alt: Tsubame Kirisawa, Hakuba West · point guard

story_last_five/nori.alt: Nori Abe, Manager and analyst, second year

story_last_five/mikael.alt: Mikael Sorrel, Onda Commercial · defensive guard

story_last_five/cover.alt: Cover art for Last Five: Rebuild the team. Beat the five who left.
